privacy.text: Zen Ramen & Sushi (“we,” “our,” or “us”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.

Improve our website and customer experience

We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with trusted third-party service providers that help us operate our website, process payments, manage reservations, or provide marketing services.

We take reasonable measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, disclosure, or misuse. However, no internet transmission is completely secure.
Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those websites.
You may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information by contacting us.
